rationale: At 21 signers ML-DSA-44 uses 50,820 signature bytes, ML-DSA-87 uses 97,167, and SLH-DSA-256s uses 625,632; all fit the 984,260-byte structural carrier while preserving algorithm-change headroom. The 400-signer N5 retention sizing is a separate rotation/resource bound and is not reduced by this launch cap.
